basic.name: Shock Ray
basic.description: Channel a beam of Psionic energy, dealing 280~~0.04~~ damage and Slowing enemies in a line by 30% for 2 seconds.

basic.name: Psionic Storm
basic.description: Create a Psionic Storm at the targeted location for 3 seconds. While in a storm, enemies take 38~~0.04~~ damage every 0.5 seconds, increasing by 20% for each consecutive instance of damage, up to 100%.

basic.name: Force Wall
basic.description: After a 0.5 second delay, create a wall that blocks all units from moving through it for 2 seconds.

heroic.name: Archon
heroic.description:
Tassadar transforms into an Archon, gaining a Shield equal to 25% of his maximum Health and empowering Resonance Beam. Lasts for 12 seconds.

Resonance Beam: Deals 140~~0.04~~ damage to the target and splashes 70~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies. Heroes hit have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 2 seconds. Resonance Beam is fully charged while Archon is active.

heroic.name: Black Hole
heroic.description: After a 0.5 second cast, create a Black Hole that travels in a long line. Enemy Heroes within the Black Hole's area are quickly pulled towards its center. Touching the center deals 310~~0.04~~ damage and Stuns the target for 1.25 seconds.

heroic.name: Archon
heroic.description:
Tassadar transforms into an Archon, gaining a Shield equal to 25% of his maximum Health and empowering Resonance Beam. Lasts for 12 seconds.

Resonance Beam: Deals 140~~0.04~~ damage to the target and splashes 70~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies. Heroes hit have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 2 seconds. Resonance Beam is fully charged while Archon is active.

trait.name: Resonance Beam
trait.description:
Tassadar's Basic Attack is a Channeled beam that Slows by 15%. While Channeling, your Basic Attack damage and Mana regeneration increases by 25% a second, to a maximum of 100%. While at full charge, gain an extra 3 Mana every second.

This bonus is lost after 6 seconds of not Channeling.

activable.name: Oracle
activable.description:
Passive: While stationary, gain 30 Spell Armor for 0.75 seconds and restore 12~~0.04~~ Health a second.

Activate to Channel for up to 4 seconds, revealing a gradually increasing area anywhere on the map.

activable.name: Shadow Walk
activable.description:
Tassadar becomes Stealthed and Unrevealable, but cannot attack or use Abilities for 1.5 seconds. While this effect is active, gain 40% increased Movement Speed and 35 Armor.

Can be cast while Channeling Shock Ray.

activable.name: Executor's Will
activable.description: Activate to gain full Resonance Beam charge, 20% Spell Power, and cause Basic and Heroic Ability cooldowns to regenerate 25% faster. This effect lasts as long as Resonance Beam remains at full charge.

level1.name: Static Charge
level1.description:
Quest: Heroes hit by Shock Ray permanently increases its damage by 5 and grants 33% Resonance Beam charge. 

Maximum of 200 bonus damage.

level1.name: Psi-Infusion
level1.description:
Each non-Structure enemy hit by Psionic Storm restores 0.5 Mana, increased to 5 against Heroes.

Passive: Increase the cast range of Psionic Storm by 33%.

level1.name: Khaydarin Amulet
level1.description:
Quest: Resonance Beam charges 50% faster.

Reward: After Resonance Beam has been fully charged for 80 seconds, it bounces to hit 1 additional target for 75% damage, prioritizing Heroes.

Reward: After Resonance Beam has been fully charged for 160 seconds, it bounces to hit 2 additional targets for 75% damage, prioritizing Heroes.

level4.name: Induction
level4.description: Tassadar gains 10% increased Movement Speed. Casting Shock Ray increases this bonus to 30% for 3 seconds.

level4.name: Electric Fence
level4.description: Force Wall deals 92~~0.04~~ damage a second to nearby enemies and Slows them by 35%.

level4.name: Plasma Shield
level4.description: While Resonance Beam is fully charged, gain a Shield equal to 3% of max Health every second, stacking up to 12%.

level7.name: Beam Alignment
level7.description:
While Resonance Beam is fully charged, Shock Ray's cooldown refreshes 100% faster and its Slow duration is increased to 4 seconds.

Passive: Reduce the Mana cost of Shock Ray from 55 to 40.

level7.name: Psionic Echo
level7.description: Casting Psionic Storm causes your next Shock Ray within 3 seconds to only cost 30 Mana and create a Psionic Storm on the first enemy Hero hit.

level7.name: Arc Discharge
level7.description:
When Resonance Beam is fully charged, Tassadar's Basic Attack range is increased by 1 and its next instance of damage also creates a Psionic Storm on the target.

This effect has a 20 second cooldown that decays twice as fast while Resonance Beam is fully charged.

level13.name: Feedback
level13.description: When an enemy Hero is affected by Psionic Storm, Resonance Beam's Slow is increased to 50% and it reduces Physical Armor by 25.

level16.name: Thermal Lance
level16.description: Shock Ray deals an additional 8% of maximum Health as damage to the first Hero it hits.

level16.name: Executor's Will

level20.name: Twilight Archon
level20.description: Basic Attacks while in Archon form increase its duration by 2 seconds.

level20.name: Kugelblitz
level20.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Black Hole's center have their Armor reduced by 20 for 3 seconds and have a Psionic Storm created at their location.

level20.name: Force Barrier
level20.description: Increase the duration of Force Wall by 0.5 seconds, its cast range by 50%, and reduce its cooldown by 10 seconds.

level20.name: Khala's Gift
level20.description: Gain 4% Spell Power for yourself and each nearby ally Hero, up to 20% total Spell Power. Your total bonus is shared with all contributing allies.
